title: Getting Started with Web Development
author: Alex Tan
content: I started learning web development this semester, and building small projects has helped me understand HTML, CSS and JavaScript much better. My advice is to start with a simple page, practise one concept at a time, and avoid worrying too much about making everything perfect on the first attempt.

title: How I Organise My Study Week
author: Jade Lim
content: At the beginning of each week, I list my assignments, classes and personal tasks. I split larger assignments into smaller steps and give each step a realistic deadline. This makes it easier to see what needs attention and leaves some time for breaks.

title: What I Learned from My First Group Project
author: Thiha Aung
content: Working on a group project taught me that agreeing on file structures and naming conventions early can save a lot of time. We also found it useful to make small commits and review each other's changes before merging them. Clear communication made the work easier to coordinate.
